parsing.method: Fixed-width text block extracted from the captured HTML (td.courier2); rows split on whitespace after the header lines were matched exactly against the expected layout.
transformations:
Non-breaking spaces and
converted to spaces and line breaks.
Dates given as MM/DD/YY also stored as ISO dates, reading the year as 20YY.
Numeric strings also stored as numbers; the original string is kept and is what the site displays.
parsing.missingValues: The markers --, --- and NA are kept as written. The source does not define them. They are never converted to zero.
